rows.adsb_note: SAYS ALMOST NOTHING. adsb-lol/airplanes-live served other airframes that day but holds no trace for this one. Parked with the transponder off, outside receiver coverage, and a wrong claimed date all look identical from here. AN ABSENCE IS NOT A FINDING.
rows.source: Researcher-compiled timeline circulated on X; audit indices 10, 11, 15, 46
rows.counterargument: 130 MILES IS NOT AN OVERLAP - Jefferson City has its own airport (KJEF). An 11-week SU-BND stay is a heavy-check maintenance stay, not an operation. NEITHER KIRK IS PLACED IN MISSOURI on any date in this window by any source; the Kirk side is an organisation's event, not a person's location. SU-BTT flew its standard Cairo->Paris->US field->sit->Wilmington->Cairo rotation unchanged. THE COMPILER FOOTNOTED HIS OWN WEAKNESS: his note reads 'Event is in Jefferson City, MO (2 hrs from St. Louis)'.
rows.notes: ADDED FROM THE OVERLAP PAGE, which had no row in this file. The clustering claim's MISSOURI leg rests substantially on this one date; if the two-hour drive disqualifies it, Missouri thins out considerably. Three separate metro airports are in play (KSTL Missouri, KCPS ILLINOIS, KSUS Missouri) and a state-level tally cannot distinguish them.

rows.adsb_note: SAYS ALMOST NOTHING. adsb-lol/airplanes-live served other airframes that day but holds no trace for this one. Parked with the transponder off, outside receiver coverage, and a wrong claimed date all look identical from here. AN ABSENCE IS NOT A FINDING.
rows.source: Researcher-compiled timeline circulated on X; audit indices 20 (partial) and 21 (inaccurate)
rows.counterargument: A CHAPTER OPENING IS NOT A KIRK APPEARANCE - nothing places Charlie Kirk in Lincoln on this date. The aircraft arrived 9 Feb and left 14 Feb: it did not arrive for the event and did not leave with it. THE DOCUMENTARY COUNTERARGUMENT IS DECISIVE: a Duncan Aviation press release of 29 Oct 2015 records a five-year direct contract with the Egyptian Air Force and states Duncan has managed the EAF Falcon fleet's maintenance SINCE 1999 - fifteen years before Charlie Kirk's public career. AND THE 2023 COUNTER-CASE IS STRONGER: on 25 Aug 2023 Charlie Kirk actually spoke in Lincoln, and the audit places the aircraft IN EGYPT that day.
rows.notes: ADDED FROM THE OVERLAP PAGE, which had no row in this file. The clearest genuine same-airport co-location in the directory - and the one with the most ordinary explanation sitting directly on top of it. A weaker item sits three days earlier: Charlie Kirk's campus tour was publicly ANNOUNCED on 8 Feb 2024 and SU-BTT arrived at Omaha the next morning. AN ANNOUNCEMENT IS NOT A LOCATION.
